verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an official, hosted, remote MCP server (sandbox and live endpoints, OAuth/API-key auth) that lets agents like Claude and Cursor perform real account actions—pricing, billing, refunds, subscription changes—plus a separate docs MCP server and agent skills, all corroborated by an independent probe confirming the docs URL. This is a first-party, production MCP integration well beyond a generic API wrapper. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user report of connecting an agent to the live MCP server (only vendor docs and a URL probe, no third-party usage account).
